forbidden.comment: The site never imports the brand studio: the studio is a separate root that renders from the site's components.
forbidden.name: site-never-imports-studio

forbidden.comment: Features are isolated vertical slices: a feature may use domain/, ui/ and shell/ (i18n, seo, the logger) but never another feature.
forbidden.name: no-cross-feature-imports

forbidden.comment: domain/ holds pure domain types, ports and algorithms; it imports no other layer.
forbidden.name: domain-is-pure

forbidden.comment: Features never import adapters/: views and hooks consume ports (CatalogRepository, ProductSearch).
forbidden.name: features-never-import-adapters

forbidden.comment: Only shell/ (the composition root) wires adapters.
forbidden.name: only-shell-wires-adapters

forbidden.comment: Only adapters/ may touch a provider SDK (zod, Firebase, Google Cloud, Gen AI, ADK, Google auth), resolved or not: a provider stays behind a port.
forbidden.name: adapters-own-providers

forbidden.comment: ui/ primitives take localized strings as props; they never import i18n.
forbidden.name: ui-stays-i18n-free

forbidden.comment: features/admin is entered only through the shell's guarded boundary (shell/admin/AdminSection.tsx, lazy + RequireAdmin).
forbidden.name: admin-only-from-composition-root
